environment.description: Service deployed on ECS Fargate behind AWS PrivateLink interface endpoint (com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890). Task definition specifies readonlyRootFilesystem=true with an ephemeral storage mount at /tmp scoped per-task (20GB Fargate ephemeral storage, not shared). Network configuration uses awsvpc mode with security group sg-0abc123def456 allowing inbound only from VPC endpoint ENI prefix list (pl-0123456789abcdef0). No public IP assignment, no NAT gateway route to internet. Service discovery via Cloud Map namespace internal.processing.local. The VPC endpoint policy restricts invoking principals to role arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/DocProcessingClient only.

config.network_mode: awsvpc, no public IP, no IGW/NAT route
